queries.query:
// Plot 1 — supplyFlowTma as-is
plot1 = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lsst.sal.HVAC.glycolSensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "supplyFlowTma")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "supplyFlowTma"}))

// Plot 2a — M1M3 flow rate
m1m3 = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTM1M3TS.flowMeter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "flowRate")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value + 135.0}))    // ← change here

// Plot 2b — Chiller GlycInputFlow × 3.785 (gal → L conversion)
chiller = from(bucket: "lsst.MTCamera/autogen")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lsst.MTCamera.chiller_maq20")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "GlycInputFlow")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 3.785}))

// Plot 2 — Sum of 2a + 2b
plot2 = join(
    tables: {m1m3: m1m3, chiller: chiller},
    on: ["_time"]
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time:  r._time,
      _value: r._value_m1m3 + r._value_chiller,
      _field: "Total_Flow_M1M3_Chiller"
  }))

// Return both lines on the same chart
union(tables: [plot1, plot2])
